summary: Defender XDR assignments no longer wait for the daily prerequisite check after an update.

fixes.title: Defender judged from the live roles at once
fixes.text: Each engine run judges the Defender XDR prerequisites from the live Defender roles it already read, so assignments that a new version allows are made on the first run instead of the next day.

fixes.title: Prerequisites checked right after an update
fixes.text: The prerequisite check runs once on the first engine run after an update, so a new version's rules show in PIM Manager within minutes.
